proposal.reason: Main change is communicator-level configuration control: init/parse/env override, validation, defaults, and cross-rank propagation for nChannelsPerNetPeer, graphUsageMode, and maxP2pPeers. Enqueue also needs review because graph-capture/strong-stream behavior and P2P plan channel selection logic changed in runtime scheduling paths. Device-topology needs review because P2P channel computation in graph/paths now uses explicit per-network-peer channels and max-peer-based tuning, which changes path/channel allocation behavior.
